facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: fire on SG-4100 during a breakdown response

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus on SG-4100 and TX-3002 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on SG-4100 and TX-3002 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. SG-4100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 28 October 2009 an incident occurred on SG-4100 and TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
